publisher: Upwork Inc., Forms 10-K (CIK 1627475), Key Financial and Operational Metrics
readBy: each fiscal year's 10-K GSV line as printed (thousands of USD); FY2016–2017 from the FY2018 10-K Selected Financial Data; every overlapping year agrees across consecutive 10-Ks; per-value filing URLs in sec-upwork-fiverr-citations.json; FY2025 10-K re-read by the lead (4,028,386 / 4,008,107 / 4,142,252)
definitionBreak: FY2018 10-K: GSV = client spend on the marketplace and managed services plus fees for withdrawals and currency exchange. FY2025 10-K: GSV = the total dollar value transacted through all Upwork platforms and other workforce solutions, including AI-based services, Connects purchases, payment processing, memberships, and currency services. Prior years were not restated.
